correctness.rationale: TARGET route: proved alternative (A) for the admitted q=5 duplication Lattes map. Verified: tame PCF ramification (6 simple critical points, local degree 2, multiplier 4 at infinity, empty exceptional set), tent-map skeleton action with total invariance L^{-1}(Sigma)=Sigma, Montel placement V in Fatou, torsion ledger L^{-n}(infty)=x(E[2^n]) with counts 2^{2n-1}+2 and dyadic equidistribution to Lebesgue measure identifying Julia as Sigma, no attracting cycles via critical orbits to indifferent infinity, and rank-one fiber finiteness (rational boundary preperiodic under T plus finite-field direction dynamics) forcing every disk preperiodic. Artifact rerun reproduced counts and discrepancy 2^{-n}. Black-box invocations (Montel, Baker-Rumely equidistribution, Julia-as-support, Rivera-Letelier) are cited and correctly applied; map-specific inputs are proved.

originality.rationale: Fused retrieval (SerpBase/OpenAlex/Crossref/OpenAIRE, partial=false) found no prior stating the q=5 Tate duplication Fatou list or no-wandering verdict. Nearest prior (Rivera-Letelier 2026) proves wandering Lattes existence only when Q-rank>=2, explicitly excluding this Q-rank-1 C5 case. General classification tools and expository Lattes material do not imply the exact single-map list. Synonymous encodings, dual/complement forms, broader censuses, and database lookups were tested and do not cover the headline; see decisive_checks.

value.rationale: Complete TARGET resolution deciding the admitted (A)/(B) dichotomy with exact Fatou list (Julia=Sigma segment, Fatou=complement preperiodic indifferent disks, D_infty fixed multiplier 4, postcritical tree to infinity, no wandering). Object and invariant were motivated before computation as the rank-1 boundary outside the known rank>=2 wandering construction; value is not known or mechanically implied and is retrievable for non-archimedean dynamics. Not a textbook restatement, parameter substitution, tiny gain, or unexplained enumeration.
